task.description: Implement OIDC-03 in backend code per src/design/oidc-03-configuration-source.md. Add startup configuration loading and validation for active identity provider selection (environment variables until Stage 10), enforce required fields (provider type, base URL, admin credentials reference, default realm/tenant identifier), wire provider bootstrap selection by configuration, and return clear startup errors naming invalid fields. Preserve provider-agnostic boundaries outside adapter modules. Run required validations: zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate, and error-set check before completion.
acceptance_criteria: OIDC-03 behavior implemented and validated against the design artifact
Switching provider type selects corresponding adapter via configuration path
Invalid or missing configuration returns clear startup error with field attribution
zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate all pass

result.summary: Implemented OIDC-03 startup configuration loading and provider bootstrap selection. Added environment-based identity-provider config schema/validation for required fields, wired startup bootstrap by provider type (keycloak/stub), emitted field-attributed startup errors for invalid configuration, and preserved provider-agnostic boundaries outside adapter modules.
result.next_action: Route to TEST-DESIGNER for OIDC-03 test specification and startup-failure matrix coverage.
